hero.headline: Healing the Sacred
hero.sentence: Restoring Onondaga Lake through Story, Ceremony, and Public Scholarship
hero.coverAlt: Healing the Sacred: Restoring Onondaga Lake through Story, Ceremony, and Public Scholarship, lettered in ochre gold over native fish and an eel swimming through teal water above a lakebed littered with a barrel, a tire, a plastic bottle and a plastic bag.

letter.heading: Why we made this podcast
paragraphs: Onondaga Lake is the sacred site where Gayanashagowa, the Great Law of Peace, was established. The Onondaga Nation, one of six nations of the Haudenosaunee Confederacy, is petitioning the Organization of American States for land rights to the lake. Industrial pollution has desecrated it.

This podcast brings together story, ceremony, and public scholarship. Listeners will hear about the history of the lake, its significance to the Haudenosaunee Confederacy, the consequences of its pollution, and the work of restoring it.
We hold that returning Onondaga Lake to the Onondaga Nation is a vital step toward restoring this sacred place and toward healing for its people, the surrounding communities, and the natural world.
letter.imageAlt: A detail of the cover painting: fish and an eel swimming through the teal water of Onondaga Lake.
